data.context: In the 2024 IP Australia Economic Research Paper 16, *Computer implemented inventions: patent trends at IP Australia, EPO and USPTO*, this section reports a difference-in-differences analysis of grant probabilities for computer-implemented invention applications filed in 2010–2017. It compares IP Australia, EPO and USPTO outcomes before and after 2014 for applications classified as likely adverse under the CII-PSM, including patent families filed simultaneously at all three offices.
